title: Analysis data pipeline tests
description:
Add focused Catch2 (or existing project harness) unit tests covering AnalysisFifo SPSC drop behavior, PerformanceHistory duration/ring, NoiseFingerprint/AlignmentScopeData buffers, and Attack/Tail integrity ratios.

Before editing, inspect:
- tests/TestMain.cpp and existing tests/* patterns from prior phases
- Source/Analysis/* public APIs from h.1–h.4
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §20, §28.2, Appendix A.4 A_r formula
- CMakeLists.txt test registration from h.5 (do not re-own CMake — prefer zero CMake edits)

Implement tests/AnalysisTests.cpp:
1) AnalysisFifo: prepare small capacity; push until full; further tryPush returns false and does not block; tryPop drains in order; drop count increments when applicable; QualityMode Off path does not retain frames if push gated by mode on the unit under test.
2) PerformanceHistory: setDurationSeconds within 2–30; push known sequences; copyRecent returns matching envelope/threshold/state/gain/transient/sustain series within tolerances; wrapping beyond capacity retains most recent.
3) NoiseFingerprint: after prepare, setSpectrum/updateFromLearnedProfile fills getNumBins magnitudes; magnitude length matches bins.
4) AlignmentScopeData: set onset waveforms + correlation + setResult(offset, confidence); getters echo values; buffer lengths fixed after prepare.
5) AttackIntegrityAnalyzer: synthetic windows where y==x → A_r ≈ 1 preserved; y≈0 with nonzero x → missed; intermediate → partial; counts update.
6) TailIntegrityAnalyzer: synthetic main long decay + professionalized short output with high sustain confidence → choke flag/score elevated; matched decays → low choke.

Keep tests deterministic (fixed lengths, explicit float tolerances). No audio hardware. Only write tests/AnalysisTests.cpp registered by h.5.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: tests/AnalysisTests.cpp exists and registers multiple test cases
FIFO tests assert non-blocking full-drop behavior and ordered pop
PerformanceHistory tests cover duration bounds and series copyRecent fidelity
NoiseFingerprint and AlignmentScopeData tests cover fixed buffer ingest and readback
AttackIntegrityAnalyzer tests assert A_r classification for preserved/partial/missed synthetics
TailIntegrityAnalyzer tests assert choke detection vs matched-decay baseline
tests are deterministic with explicit numeric tolerances
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: depend on real-time audio devices or host plugins

allowed: use Catch2 TEST_CASE/SECTION style matching existing tests
synthesize deterministic frame sequences and energy windows as fixtures
use float absolute/relative tolerances for A_r and buffer comparisons
forbidden: edit production Analysis or PluginProcessor sources
depend on real-time audio devices or host plugins
